The '''1986–87 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 51st season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece. The season began on 7 September 1986 and ended on 7 June 1987. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their 25th Greek title and their first one in four years. The championship was marked by the strike declared by 12 clubs in the last three matchdays of the championship. As a result, most of the clubs did not come to the last matches of the championship and were punished by deducting 6 points. The clubs that did not joined the strike were Olympiacos, [[Panathinaikos F.C.|Panathinaikos]], [[OFI Crete F.C.|OFI]] and [[Panionios F.C.|Panionios]], which finished at the first four places of the standings.<ref name="Strike">{{Cite web|url=https://www.contra.gr/stiles/to-podosfairo-apergei.7236470.html|title=Το ποδόσφαιρο απεργεί|website=contra.gr}}</ref>

The point system was: ''Win: 2 points'' - ''Draw: 1 point''.
